question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The government is proposing to __incinerate__ cattle carcasses at many sites, some of which are in populated areas.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incinerate"** means to destroy something by burning it completely. (जलाकर नष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The waste was **incinerated** to reduce its volume.
 
 
 
• **"Extinguish"** refers to putting out a fire or light; to cause something to stop burning. (बुझाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters worked tirelessly to **extinguish** the blaze.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'incinerate'** is **'extinguish'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Oxidise **(ऑक्सीडाइज़): To combine or become combined chemically with oxygen.

 
 
• **Example:** Iron tends to **oxidise** when exposed to moisture.
 
 
 
• **Blaze **(ज्वाला): A very large or fiercely burning fire.
 
 
• **Example:** The forest fire **blazed** for hours before it was brought under control.
 
 
 
• **Combust **(जलना): To catch fire or cause to catch fire and burn.
 
 
• **Example:** The dry leaves can easily** combust** if exposed to a spark.
